description: This file defines a Java class 'Criteria' used for representing query criteria, including pagination and sorting options, within the application.

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: A Java bean that encapsulates query criteria including start index, maximum count, code, and order settings.

methods.name: getMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to fetch.

methods.name: setMaxCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to fetch.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index for the query results.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the starting index for the query results.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the criteria.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the criteria.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the order (ascending or descending) for sorting.

methods.name: setOrderBy
methods.description: Sets the order (ascending or descending) for sorting.
